SD: Sum of squares (Σx²)

Sum of the squared x-values. Needed to compute both standard deviations from S-SUM totals.

Σx² is the sum of each observation squared (with frequency if you used one). It is not (Σx)².

formula
∑x2=x12​+x22​+⋯+xn2​
FreqOn: ∑x2=∑xi2​fi​
keys
SHIFT→1→1→EXE

Example

Square each number first, then add those squares (this is not “add first, then square”).

Data: 2, 4, 6, 8 (four numbers)
2² = 4
4² = 16
6² = 36
8² = 64
Σx² = 4 + 16 + 36 + 64 = 120
steps

On the calculator

  1. MODE→1→EXE (4. If you were already in SD, SHIFT 9 (Stat) to clear the old list)
  2. 2→DT
  3. 4→DT
  4. 6→DT
  5. 8→DT
  6. then AC
  7. SHIFT→1→1→EXE→Σx² = 120

This total is what the machine uses internally for σx and sx:

σx=n∑x2​−xˉ2​
sx=n−1∑x2−nxˉ2​​
note

SHIFT 1 → 1 is Σx²; SHIFT 1 → 2 is Σx. Mixing the two is a common keying error.
